notes: PHF AI Sandbox - Checklist READ-ONLY demo tool cho BGD (Admin-only). Them lib/ai-checklist-tools.js: adapter READ-ONLY goi LAI dung ham da kiem chung cua Checklist (lib/checklist-reports.js#getChecklistCurrentScoreReport - chinh la nguon 'Dashboard Diem Checklist - che do HIEN TAI' ma man Bao cao Checklist dang dung, cong thuc 100-tong points cua violation record_status='official' is_test=false trong ky, nguon nhan su tu checklist_employee_assignments qua getChecklistReportAccess). Khong tu dinh nghia lai cong thuc diem, khong tu query Supabase, khong ghi/sua/xoa gi. lib/ai-sandbox.js nay dung DeepSeek tool-calling (OpenAI-compatible tools/tool_choice) voi DUY NHAT 1 tool whitelist server-side 'get_checklist_lowest_employees' (limit 1-10 clamp cung, department/branch optional string filter, khong nhan raw SQL/URL/table name); ten tool khac model tu bia se bi tu choi (TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED), khong bao gio cham Supabase. Luot 2 (sau khi co tool result) KHONG gui lai tools -> tranh vong lap goi tool vo han. Chi gui DeepSeek dung TOP result da duoc gioi han (employeeCode/employeeName/department/branch/checklistScore) - khong gui ca bang, khong email/phone/salary/permission. Session day du (khong chi sub) duoc truyen vao runChatSandbox de tool doc dung quyen Checklist that su cua nguoi goi qua requireSession(['admin']) + getChecklistReportAccess (cung engine voi man Bao cao, khong tao permission moi). Khong sua bat ky file nghiep vu Checklist nao (checklist-reports.js, checklist-permissions.js, checklist-violations.js, assets/js/checklist/* deu khong doi). Tool 2 (ly do tru diem/loi lap lai) CHUA lam trong batch nay, chi Tool 1 (diem thap nhat) theo dung pham vi demo dau da duoc yeu cau.
